summary: UNIQLO is japanese casual wear designer, manufacturer and retailer, founded in 1984. About 20,853 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 50% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: UNIQLO is the Japanese casual-wear retailer owned by Fast Retailing, expanding in Europe, with IND sponsor status for its Dutch branch.

culture.text: A brand of Fast Retailing with more than 2,500 stores worldwide.
Its 2 open jobs here are entry-level roles in sales and operations, in Rotterdam and Amsterdam.

open.text: UNIQLO Europe Ltd's Dutch branch is an IND recognised sponsor.
One of its 2 current postings needs no Dutch and one mentions visa or relocation; both average about 200 LinkedIn applicants.

growth.text: Postings say UNIQLO is expanding fast across the UK and Europe.
It is opening new stores, such as a large World Trade Center store, its fourth New York opening of 2026.
Wikidata lists 30,000 employees in 2023 and 20,853 in 2025.
